name: Generic TCP/UDP
notes: Complete list: 2 actions (actions.js), no feedbacks (index.js registers only setActionDefinitions; no feedbacks file exists).

Config: host (regex is a local hostname/IP pattern), port (textinput, default 7000, Regex.PORT), prot (tcp or udp, default tcp), broadcast (UDP only), saveresponse and convertresponse (TCP only). Config fields are not part of the schema.

send: the id_send text is passed through JavaScript unescape() (so %hh inserts a byte), then id_end is appended and the result is sent as a latin1 buffer. An empty command sends nothing. The tooltip marks the action OBSOLETE in favour of send_hex.

send_hex: id_send_hex is decoded with Buffer.from(hex); an odd length gets a leading '0' and decoding stops at the first non-hex digit (tooltip). The id_end character is appended. Nothing is sent when the decoded buffer is empty.
The default of id_end differs: '\n' (LF) for send, '' (None) for send_hex. Choice ids are the literal control characters, as written in the source.
Over TCP the data is only sent while the socket is connected; otherwise the module only logs at debug level.
Built on @companion-module/base ^1.14.1: options do not support expressions.
